SOURCE_FIELD: ATTRIBUTION_V2_EXECUTION_UNIVERSE.csv -> DIRECTION column for that ANALYSIS_OBJECT_ID
COMPUTATION: constant per analysis object: LONG -> 1, SHORT -> 0, BOTH -> NULL
DECISION_TIME_AVAILABILITY: AT_DECISION -- it is a property of the frozen representative, fixed before any trade exists
MISSINGNESS_RULE: NULL for the 89 objects whose DIRECTION is BOTH; that is an expected, declared absence, not a defect

COMPUTATION: entry_price = the trade's actual fill (engine convention: open of decision_bar+1); stop_price = the setup's stop, fixed on the decision bar; ATR is read at the DECISION bar, never at the entry bar
DECISION_TIME_AVAILABILITY: AT_FILL -- the stop and the ATR are decision-bar quantities, but the fill price is the next bar's OPEN. Outcome-free and fixed before any bar of the trade's life elapses. See the disclosure note.
BINNING_RULE: 5 causal quintiles on a trailing-2000-TRADE percentile rank within the analysis object, shifted by 1 trade (same frozen quintile rule, applied on the trade axis because the quantity exists only per trade)
MISSINGNESS_RULE: NULL where ATR is non-finite or <= 0 at the decision bar, or where the ledger carries no stop; recorded as NOT_AVAILABLE_FOR_FAMILY ; ALSO NULL for any object supplied only as a pre-existing trade log that carries no stop and no fill price (verified: STRATEGY_ATTRIBUTION_MASTER_TABLE.csv has neither) -- for those 14 objects either REGENERATE from the object's own generator, which yields stop and fill, or record NOT_AVAILABLE_FOR_FAMILY. Do not impute and do not substitute a proxy.

SOURCE_FIELD: setup['dir'] (or the sign of the trade's direction field in the regenerated ledger)
COMPUTATION: +1 for a long commitment, -1 for a short commitment; encode bin 1 for LONG, 0 for SHORT
DECISION_TIME_AVAILABILITY: AT_DECISION -- the side is fixed by the signal on the decision bar, before any fill
BINNING_RULE: 2 levels: 0 = SHORT, 1 = LONG (frozen; N_BINS already published as 2)
MISSINGNESS_RULE: never missing for a real trade; if a ledger row has no direction, emit NULL and count it as NOT_AVAILABLE_FOR_FAMILY -- do not impute
